title: agoRAbbits Drinks
description: Adds 5 Juices as well as Milk- and Chocolatemilk bottles
body:
**agoRAbbits Drinks** adds 5 Juices as well as Milk- and Chocolatemilk bottles.

![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4762befab95773b003265cb34a1e9a9b6e888cdb.png)
 
 
 
Each drink has its own effect:
- Beetroot Juice: Gives 60 Seconds Haste
- Carrot Juice: Gives 60 Seconds Jump Boost
- Glowberry Juice: Gives 60 Seconds Night Vision
- Melon Juice: Gives 60 Seconds Water Breathing
- Sweetberry Juice: Gives 60 Seconds Luck
- Milk Bottle: Removes all Effects
- Chocolatemilk Bottle: Removes only bad Effects
